newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - BANKING STOCKS FEATURE.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - BANKING STOCKS FEATURE.

text.p: Botswana Stock Exchange last week although overall trading
Barclays and Standard Chartered each gained 10 thebe to 400
and 380 thebe respectively, and First National put on five thebe
Realestate Development was the only other stock to gain
rising five thebe to 155. Sechaba lost 10 thebe to 245 thebe.
The number of shares traded dropped to 36,200 shares worth
Pula 156,680 from 51,280 shares worth Pula 230,439 the week
The index dropped 1.7 to close at 344.12 points.
